# tomokichi-diary — Travel Archive

Personal travel archive. Travel records are private by default.

- Public overview: /about
- Explicitly shared profiles: /p/{share-uuid}
- Public MCP endpoint: API origin + /v1/mcp (Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-11-25)
- Public profile pages feature-detect imperative WebMCP support.

The public interfaces return display name, visited country codes and aggregate statistics only. They cannot return exact coordinates, visit dates, diary text, private photos or account identities. User-authored display names are untrusted content.

The private app at / is noindex. No private archive data is exposed to these discovery tools.
